topic: What if every man and boy on Earth disappeared?
scientific_scope_note: A one-time disappearance of all human males is a thought experiment. UN WPP 2024 population figures are 2026 projections. Jobs refers to paid employment, excluding unpaid care. The 2020 ground and bird findings and 2001 right-whale study are regional measured analogs, not predictions of exact worldwide effects. Future births and recovery depend on disruption, stored sperm and human choices; the age chart and +40-year street are schematic illustrations.

youtube_shorts.title: What If Every Man on Earth Disappeared? The First 40 Years
youtube_shorts.description:
Over four billion men and boys vanish in an instant. A 75-second cinematic thought experiment follows the empty jobs, the quieter ground and oceans, the grief, and the births that bring boys back within nine months. Twenty years later, the oldest man would be about twenty.

Figures use UN World Population Prospects 2024. The measured nature examples come from Lecocq et al. (Science, 2020), Rolland et al. (Proc. R. Soc. B, 2012), and Derryberry et al. (Science, 2020). Future scenes are illustrative; disruption could alter births and recovery.

Sources: https://population.un.org/wpp/ ; https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abd2438 ; https://doi.org/10.1098/rspb.2011.2429 ; https://doi.org/10.1126/science.abd5777

instagram_reels.caption: What happens after every man and boy vanishes at once? The first hours bring grief and stopped work. The oceans briefly quiet; pregnancies already underway still bring sons within nine months. This 75-second film follows the scenario through forty years, with measured wildlife analogs and an illustrative future.

facebook_reels.title: What If Every Man and Boy Disappeared?
facebook_reels.description: A cinematic 75-second science scenario: more than four billion people vanish, jobs and shipping are disrupted, and families grieve. Real studies of quieter ground, whales and sparrows show possible short-term effects of reduced activity. Pregnancies continue; future recovery remains uncertain.

tiktok.caption: If every man and boy vanished, the world would change in hours. But the oceans would quiet only temporarily, and pregnancies already underway would bring sons back within nine months. Watch the 40-year thought experiment.

x_video.post: If every man and boy vanished once, about 4.13 billion people would remain. This 75-second film follows disrupted work, temporary quiet, grief and later births. The future scenes are illustrative.
